title: Milk

source.name: Simple English Wikipedia — Milk
source.note: Chuyển thể sang mức A1 (câu ngắn, từ đơn giản); thông tin theo bài gốc.

paras: Milk is a white liquid. Mammals make milk. Cows, dogs and people make milk. A mother makes milk for her baby. Babies drink milk before they eat food. Milk helps babies grow. Milk also has calcium. Calcium is good for bones and teeth.
Keep milk cold in a refrigerator. If milk is not cold, it becomes sour after some time. People make cream, butter, yogurt, ice cream and cheese from milk.
